name: Graph tab: field rows stop selecting once the text box has been used

comments.text: Reproduced in the real editor: select field b, click the text box and type, then click field a. The highlight stays on b, and clicking elsewhere first or clearing the text does not help. Clicking a then b works before the text box has been used. Likely a focus or pointer-capture detail in the input (Penumbra), not the page's handlers (onRelease sets chosenField).
